## Gameplay, Animations & User Experience
- **Handstand Animation:** Refined Capri's vertical positioning during handstand animations for improved visual alignment.
- **Application Launch Responses:** Made Capri's responses shorter and more concise when opening applications, resulting in smoother and more natural interactions.
- **Tic-Tac-Toe:** Enlarged the game window and added a brief thinking delay before Capri makes her moves.
- **Chess:** Enlarged the chess window and introduced move history, forward/backward navigation, and 180° board rotation, inspired by Chess.com.
- **2048:** Slightly increased the game window size and improved victory and defeat detection.
- **Contextual Game Reactions:** Added dynamic, context-aware dialogue based on player performance, mistakes, critical moments, and game outcomes across Tic-Tac-Toe, Chess, and 2048.
- **Windows Animation Fixes:** Resolved issues preventing certain animations from playing correctly on Windows.

## Settings & Configuration
- **Capri Cursor:** Changed the default setting to disabled for new installations. Existing user preferences remain unchanged.
- **Discord Rich Presence:** Disabled by default for new installations, while remaining available as an optional feature that users can enable manually.

## Fixes, Optimizations & Improvements
- Fixed various bugs and inconsistencies across the application.
- Improved performance, stability, and overall responsiveness.
- Optimized internal processes and refined existing functionality.
- Applied minor UI, usability, and code-quality improvements.
